Interface VirtualServerSocket

All Superinterfaces:
VirtualServer
All Known Implementing Classes:
SocketServerHandler
public interface VirtualServerSocket extends VirtualServer
Interface representing the virtual server for socket-based communication on the client side. Extends VirtualServer to define specific methods for sending requests to the server.
